clips.title: The story
paras: A letter from Ironforge reaches Grelin Whitebeard at his camp in Coldridge Valley. The dispatch carries news and instructions to the experienced dwarf on the snowy frontier.

Grelin Whitebeard receives word from Ironforge at his wilderness campsite. Coldridge Valley can feel far from the safety of Anvilmar, and letters connect scouts and scholars in the field with the halls of the mountain capital. This missive has traveled south along the mountain paths to reach him.
